description: This file defines the 'AssignGroups' class responsible for handling group assignment functionalities within the SecurityGroups module of SuiteCRM. It includes methods for popup selection, load-on events, and mass assignment of security groups, integrating with the application's security and user interface logic.

classes.name: AssignGroups
classes.description: A class encapsulating the logic for assigning security groups to beans, managing UI popups, and mass assignment within the SuiteCRM SecurityGroups module.

methods.name: popup_select
methods.description: Handles the popup selection for assigning security groups or users based on the module context, processing requests and updating relationships.

methods.name: popup_onload
methods.description: Manages the load event of the popup, injecting JavaScript for record selection and handling session data for dynamic UI updates.

methods.name: mass_assign
methods.description: Performs mass assignment of security groups to multiple records, with UI confirmation and session-based data management.
